spf_fail.reason: SPF check failed - server not allowed to send for this domain

spf_softfail.reason: SPF soft-fail - sender server is not clearly allowed

dkim_fail.reason: DKIM signature failed - message may be altered or forged

dmarc_fail.reason: DMARC failed - sender domain is likely spoofed

auth_all_pass.reason: SPF, DKIM and DMARC all passed

reply_to_mismatch.reason: Replies go to a different domain than the sender

return_path_mismatch.reason: Bounce address domain differs from sender

display_name_has_email.reason: Display name contains an e-mail address (classic spoof trick)

brand_impersonation.reason: Mentions brand '{v}' but is not sent from its real domain

lookalike_sender.reason: Sender domain looks like a look-alike (digits / 'rn' / '-secure' etc.)

sender_risky_tld.reason: Sender uses a cheap / high-abuse domain ending

free_mail_sender.reason: Sent from a free webmail account

link_ip_address.reason: Link points to a raw IP address

link_shortener.reason: Link uses a URL shortener that hides the real target

link_risky_tld.reason: Link goes to a high-abuse domain ending

link_has_at.reason: Link contains '@' to hide the real host

link_many_subdomains.reason: Link has an unusually long chain of subdomains

link_text_mismatch.reason: Link text shows one site but actually goes to another

risky_attachment.reason: Dangerous attachment type (script / html / macro / exe)

archive_attachment.reason: Compressed attachment (often used to hide malware)

double_extension.reason: Attachment uses a double extension (e.g. invoice.pdf.exe)
